frozenPlan.scope: Bounded retrospective cause diagnosis of Berlin2026/2027 and Helsinki2026; all28 previously exposed city-years remain controls. No new calendar/API requests or institutional contact.
frozenPlan.domain: Unchanged model-labelled autumn Fajr/Isha runs; t continuously in[b-3,b+3]; interpolated adjusted model horizons; fixed k=9/8; free per-case q in(0,1); trims0/1/2 separately. Independently free event slopes, not recomputed outer crossing slopes.

perturbations.commonClock: Rprime=R+c, Sprime=S+c, with one constant c over the searched anchor domain. This resembles solar-clock/longitude sensitivity but is NOT a global coordinate replacement or discovered longitude.
perturbations.horizonHalfSpan: Rprime=R-h, Sprime=S+h, with constant h. Positive h widens daylight and decreases N by2h. This is sensitivity only, not a fixed angular/refraction/latitude correction.
perturbations.independentInfinityNorm: For |deltaR|,|deltaS|<=eps, necessary relaxed endpoint bound is distance(R+kS, I_f+kI_i)/(1+k). If the exact common-clock feasible projection has identical nearest-to-zero bound and attainability, it supplies a matching witness and certifies the minimax infimum. Otherwise retain separate bound/witness and report undetermined; never assume physical constraints inactive.

frozenPlan.equations: D=Bi-Sprime. Lower D bounds:0(open), Li-Sprime, (Rprime-Uf)/k. Upper D bounds:Nprime(open), Ui-Sprime, (Rprime-Lf)/k. Pairwise lower<=upper constraints are affine in(t,c) or(t,h); eliminate t exactly. Knots have separate exact source projections and bound-attainment flags.
questions: Return exact signed feasible c,h unions with strictness, infimum absolute correction and whether attained. Physical q and night constraints remain enforced.

Extract small source-cell certificates for both Berlin contradictions. First exact exhaustive pair-pair search (two Fajr+two Isha observations) and lower-cardinality verification; if no cardinality-minimal certificate is certified, label irreducible witnesses honestly and record search scope.
Helsinki audit separately freezes source parsing, smallest affine inconsistency witnesses and rounding-tie alternatives; no per-date rounding exceptions.
frozenPlan.candidateGate: A candidate needs an explicit general mechanism with a complete continuous calendar and no fitted city offsets. Any such candidate gets a separate frozen whole-calendar plan and all28 six-event comparisons. If only diagnosed uncertainty or arbitrary corrections remain, publish findings and a precise unresolved assumption rather than promote a fit.
frozenPlan.verification: Independent exact Fourier-Motzkin/interval derivation and point witnesses; independent source reparse at contradiction dates; synthetic open/closed boundaries, eliminated-variable degeneracy, physical-night failures; independent replay of all reported minima.
